description: Defines classes and interfaces for F1-U split gateway and bearer management, including adapters for GTP-U communication, and connection handling between DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers in a 3GPP network context.

classes.name: gtpu_tx_udp_gw_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for transmitting PDUs over GTP-U via UDP, passing PDUs to the IO gateway.

classes.name: gtpu_rx_f1u_adapter
classes.description: Adapter for receiving SDUs (NR-U messages) from GTP-U and passing them to the lower layer.

classes.name: network_gateway_data_gtpu_demux_adapter
classes.description: Adapter between Network Gateway data and GTP-U demux, handling PDU forwarding.

classes.name: f1u_split_gateway_du_bearer
classes.description: Represents a bearer at the CU F1-U gateway, managing GTP-U tunnels and SDU handling.

classes.name: f1u_split_connector
classes.description: Connects DU and CU-UP F1-U bearers, managing creation/removal and address info.

methods.name: on_new_pdu
methods.description: Handles new PDU data, passing it to the handler or tunnel.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects the adapter to a handler or demux.

methods.name: disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the adapter from its handler.

methods.name: connect_gtpu_demux
methods.description: Connects the demux interface for handling PDU traffic.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the bearer, releasing resources and removing it from disconnector.

methods.name: get_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address for the bearer.

methods.name: create_du_bearer
methods.description: Creates a new DU bearer with specified parameters.

methods.name: remove_du_bearer
methods.description: Removes a DU bearer based on transport layer info.

methods.name: get_du_bind_address
methods.description: Returns the bind address for a specific GNB DU ID.
